requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so classes A1 through C are accepted. Stated as a preference, so this is for ranking and not a hard restriction. Gross floor area (>= 850 sqm), capacity (60 people) and public transport proximity are not energy requirements and are excluded here.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >=. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified regulatory gross-area threshold was supplied. Energy class, public transport proximity, Turin location, and the CDP/PNRR conversion are outside the reference columns or describe future use, so they are not included.
Proximity to public transport (metro, bus, stations) is preferred, so the score must be at or above the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, within 3.0 km of 45.0677551, 7.6824892 via haversine distance, energy_class in A1–A4, B, C, and mobility score >= 71. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate, ascending. No LIMIT applied.
